generations.reason: Dense columns and wrong hand angles.
generations.prompt: Create a production AUTHORING pixel-art sprite sheet, transparent background, no text/no labels/no shadows outside sprite. Match the SAME anime chibi Survivor identity from reference images: brown tousled hair, orange scarf, navy jacket, olive trousers, brown boots and olive backpack. Exactly 9 columns and 4 rows, 36 separate whole-body frames, uniform roomy cells with TRANSPARENT gutters. ROWS ARE THE FOUR DIAGONAL DIRECTIONS, top to bottom: NORTH-EAST (aim toward image upper right), SOUTH-EAST (aim image lower right), SOUTH-WEST (aim image lower left), NORTH-WEST (aim image upper left). True diagonal body/arm posture, not cardinal bodies holding horizontal hands. All actors hold an INVISIBLE shoulder-braced rifle: DO NOT paint any gun, rail or trigger, ONLY the whole character. Both fists must be aligned along the diagonal invisible rifle axis; trigger hand closer to shoulder, support hand about a forearm farther along the aim axis. When aiming NE/NW both hands reach diagonally upward/outward; SE/SW diagonally downward/outward; never two horizontal boxing fists. Correct shoulder/elbow anatomy and perspective, same silhouette and identity. Column0: planted feet stable Aim; column1: same feet mild fire recoil at shoulder/hands, body stays grounded; column2: same feet settled rifle-ready Aim. Columns3 through8: SIX genuinely distinct walking gait phases following the same diagonal direction, body height/identity/upper-body two-handed aiming remains coherent; planted/raised alternating boots, strides and contact phases, no duplicate foot poses. Reference1 gives correct identity and six-phase locomotion/cardinal hand style; reference2 gives planted rifle-ready identity. Render the 4 new diagonals, not another n/e/s/w sheet. Crisp authored pixel shapes, consistent pixel scale, complete body with every boot fully within its cell, alpha transparent.
